scripts.text:
DECLARE @BatchSize INT
DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'SystemRefresh')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Drop Index WellServicesLoad', 0, 0


TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDTWellServicesLoad
IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad]') AND name = N'IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_DiagCode')
 DROP INDEX [IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_DiagCode] ON [dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF )
IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad]') AND name = N'IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_Member_Service_EffDate')
 DROP INDEX [IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_Member_Service_EffDate] ON [dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF )
IF  EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad]') AND name = N'IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_ProcCode')
 DROP INDEX [IX_EPSDTWellServicesLoad_ProcCode] ON [dbo].[EPSDTWellServicesLoad] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF )


SET @BatchSize = (SELECT CONVERT(INT, Value) FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'DataFlowInsertBatchSize')

SELECT 
 BatchSize = @BatchSize
